name: FatSecret Platform
tagline: Nutrition database and food diary API for barcode lookup, recipes, and calorie tracking
description: FatSecret Platform is a nutrition and food data API that provides access to a large international food database, barcode product lookup, recipe search, and food diary features for building health, diet, and fitness applications. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 client credentials (or legacy OAuth 1.0) and call REST endpoints for foods, brands, recipes, and user-linked diary data.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (client_id/client_secret) for server-side calls; optional 3-legged OAuth for user diary. Self-serve registration on platform.fatsecret.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 5,000 API calls/day; US-only data; attribution required

rate_limits: Basic: 5,000 API calls/day; Premier tiers: unlimited API calls

example.request:
curl -s 'https://platform.fatsecret.com/rest/foods/search/v1?search_expression=apple&format=json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN'
# Token: POST https://oauth.fatsecret.com/connect/token (client_credentials)

use_cases: search foods by name in a nutrition database
look up product nutrition by barcode
get detailed macros for a specific food ID
search recipes by ingredient or keyword
sync a connected user's food diary entries
